bio.text: Nan Orrock, a Democrat, was elected to the Georgia Senate in 2006 and represents the 36th Senate District.
Before joining the Senate she served 10 terms in the Georgia House of Representatives, first sworn in on January 12, 1987, where she was the first woman elected House Majority Whip.
She is a founder of the Georgia Legislative Women's Caucus and the Working Families Legislative Caucus, and was previously executive director of the Fund for Southern Communities.
